# rancher_secret_backend_role (Resource)

Manages a role on the Rancher secrets engine that mints short-lived tokens from a service account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A role that mints short-lived tokens scoped to one downstream cluster. Reading
# rancher/creds/ci returns a lease-bound token deleted from Rancher on revoke.
#
# Note: Rancher tokens inherit the service account user's RBAC; only cluster and
# TTL are scoped per-token. For least-privilege, point roles at a service account
# seeded with a purpose-built, limited Rancher user.
resource "rancher_secret_backend_role" "ci" {
  backend         = rancher_secret_backend.rancher.path
  service_account = rancher_secret_backend_service_account.admin.name

  name         = "ci"
  cluster_name = "c-m-abc123"
  description  = "CI/CD ephemeral token"
  ttl          = 3600  # 1h
  max_ttl      = 28800 # 8h
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `backend` (String) Mount path of the Rancher secrets engine.
- `name` (String) Name of the role.
- `service_account` (String) Service account (seeded token) used to mint credentials. Its user's RBAC is inherited by minted tokens.

### Optional

- `cluster_name` (String) Downstream cluster to scope minted tokens to (empty = full Rancher-server scope).
- `description` (String) Description applied to each minted Rancher token.
- `max_ttl` (Number) Maximum lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.
- `ttl` (Number) Default lease TTL in seconds for tokens minted from this role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by <backend>/roles/<name>.
terraform import rancher_secret_backend_role.ci rancher/roles/ci
```
